{{Quote|Northward Park was planted with cuttings from the Neti Jedi Master Uro Koo.|Part of a report on the Vaklin insurgency by Oniye Namada|<ref name="TTF2" />}}
'''Uro Koo''' was a famous<ref name="Welcome Jungle">{{SW|url=news/welcome-to-the-star-wars-jungle|text=Welcome to the ''Star Wars'' Jungle|int=Welcome to the Star Wars Jungle|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] who was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Cuttings from Koo were used to plant a [[Forest/Legends|forest]], which became known as [[Northward Park]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the dissolution of the Jedi Order, the park was [[Fire/Legends|burnt]] to the ground as a means of wiping out all memory of the Order's existence on Vaklin, in order to reduce the population's support for the Jedi-led [[Vaklin insurgency]] against the Empire. [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]] wrote a report titled [[I-1807-VAK]], which included information on Koo.<ref name="TTF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uro Koo was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] [[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]], an issue of the [[Star Wars: Purge – The Tyrant's Fist|''Star Wars: Purge: The Tyrant's Fist'']] mini-series written by [[Alexander Freed]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="TTF2" /> on [[January 2]], [[2013]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54468/star_wars_purge_-_the_tyrants_fist_2012_2|text=Star Wars: Purge - The Tyrant's Fist (2012) #2}}</ref>
